def f(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    for j in range(w):
        if g[h-1][j]==0: continue
        nz=[(i,g[i][j]) for i in range(h) if g[i][j]!=0]
        for k,(i,v) in enumerate(nz):
            lo = 0 if k==0 else nz[k-1][0]+1
            for r in range(lo,i): g[r][j]=v
    return g
